sloka: स वृत्र इव वज्रेण फेनेन नमुचिर् यथाअ ।बलो वा इन्द्र अशनि हतो निपपात हतः खरः ॥३-३०-२८॥
transliteration: sa vṛtra iva vajreṇa phenena namucir yathāa ।balo vā indra aśani hato nipapāta hataḥ kharaḥ ॥3-30-28॥

translations.english: Khara fell down just like Vrutra or Bala killed by Indra's thunderbolt or like Numuchi by the froth of the sea.
